toy_A_note: Linear readout from the 2D arrow vector (2 numbers per element) cannot recover all 3 force components; the depth-direction (normal) component is only partly visible. A separate 3-value vector channel recovers all 3 exactly. Pixel quantization and arrow length lam=0.02 m/N are assumed.

toy_B_mechanical_headroom_corr.setting: 40 tasks, plain ~ U(0.05,0.95), ACRO ~ N(0.92, sd) independent of plain (no true effect of plain on ACRO); 2000 reps
toy_B_mechanical_headroom_corr.note: Delta and headroom share the plain-success term, so r is inflated by construction. The paper's r=0.924 is in the range this artifact produces, so it cannot be read as evidence that overlays help most where vision fails.
